name: dialog
gotchas: `MatDialog.open()` returns immediately with a `MatDialogRef` — the dialog component itself is instantiated asynchronously, so code that needs to run after the dialog closes belongs in `afterClosed()`, not directly after the `open()` call.
Data passed via `open(Component, { data })` is only available inside the dialog component through `inject(MAT_DIALOG_DATA)` — it is not a component `@Input()`.
Closing the dialog by any means other than `MatDialogRef.close(result)` (clicking the backdrop, pressing Escape) resolves `afterClosed()` with `undefined` — callers must handle the no-result case.
